#   input     ignored by the census; present so the file keeps the
# Only a code-style cell counts: ERROR:<code> where <code> is a bare
# [a-z][a-z0-9_]* token. Everything else below asserts something a code
# A duplicate contributes nothing new: the census answer is unique.
# A code with a POSITION suffix is still a code: the suffix pins where the
# error is reported, and stripping it is what keeps a fixture that pins a
# position inside the code census. Without this row, adding @1:8 to an
# expectation would silently drop that code from coverage.
# Message- and position-style expectations are rejections, not codes.
# A bare ERROR (and an empty code) pin only "it failed".
# Value rows and near-misses are not error expectations at all.
